Scope: infrastructure networks (roads, sewage, storm water, potable water, TSE, irrigation, electrical, street lighting and telecom), the potable water and TSE pump stations, three lift stations, a mosque, the CMZ to Jeddah-Jazan linking road and the added scope of revised BOQ No. 03 (Zone 5). Contract value SAR 560 million excluding VAT.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours (the labour units in the P6 schedule update). The weekly report archive uploaded this week holds only the P6 update, so the figures below were computed from it: 52.75% actual against 52.76% planned under the revised baseline, SPI 1.00. The total hides a split: the infrastructure networks are 10.3% behind their plan, offset by the pump stations and the Zone 5 added scope, which are ahead of it.

The P6 update finishes the project 4 days after the contract date, and the works may be stopped. Project finish is scheduled on 19-Mar-2028 against the contract completion date of 15-Mar-2028, driven by the TSE pump station: 134 open activities have zero float, 93 of them in the TSE pump station and 40 in the networks. The TSE, sewage and storm network finish milestones (baseline 11, 17 and 25 October 2026) are now forecast for November 2026. The risk log, in an entry dated 26-Oct-2026, records that works on the project have not resumed pending completion of safety and security requirements, and the P6 update records no activity started or finished after 19-Oct-2026.

Progress S-curve

Cumulative physical progress (man-hour weighted) at each month end. Source: P6 update 009-wpr78-26-10-2026 and revised baseline 009-RVSD03-REV02-1.

Revised baseline (RVSD03 rev. 02) Actual
Data datePlanned %Actual %VarianceGained this weekSPI
26-Oct-202652.7652.75−0.02%—1.00

Method: each activity is weighted by its budgeted labour units in the P6 update. Planned progress spreads those units evenly between the activity's start and finish dates in the revised baseline; actual progress uses each activity's physical % complete. Monthly actuals before the data date spread completed work evenly between actual start and finish, so they are approximate. Engineering, procurement and close-out activities carry no labour units, so the measure covers the construction works. No earlier week was uploaded, so the gain this week cannot be computed.

Late milestones still show large float, because only the project finish drives float. The TSE, sewage and storm networks were due by 25-Oct-2026 in the baseline and are now forecast for November 2026, and the contractual road works milestone moves from 20-Apr-2027 to 18-Jul-2027, yet P6 shows 200 to 400 days of float on them. The network milestone "Finish of Road Works" is scheduled on 27-Mar-2027, which does not match the contractual road works milestone of 18-Jul-2027.

Data notes

  • The weekly report archive 009-wpr78-26-10-2026.rar contains only the P6 update (XER). No weekly report workbook, progress presentation, quantity, manpower or HSE sheets were uploaded, so the scope-quantities and manpower sections are left out.
  • Physical % complete was computed from the P6 update by the method under the S-curve. The tracker's Info sheet and the 3-week look-ahead report cost-based (planned and earned value) progress, which is not used here.
  • No earlier week was uploaded for this project, so this-week and gained-this-week values are shown as "—".
  • The P6 update has a data date of 26-Oct-2026, but no activity has an actual start or finish after 19-Oct-2026, nor between 06 and 12-Oct-2026. The update may not reflect the last week of work.
  • The time-stamped site photos are dated 17-Oct-2026, in the previous week.
  • The Info sheet of the procurement tracker (contract dates, value, invoicing, MODON PM) is dated 15-Jun-2026 and has not been updated.
  • Several pivot sheets of the procurement tracker (Zone 5 PO, Long Lead %, PV QTY) show #REF! errors. Some delivered quantities exceed the revised BOQ quantity, e.g. GRP pipes 86,378 m against 85,790 m and light-pole concrete bases 1,158 against 1,063.
  • The curbstone lines repeat the same quantity (160,860 m) for four types; the total needed should be confirmed.
  • Issue ID#04 in the issue log is filed under contract JDH3-02-010 with this project's name. Risk and issue scores do not follow the log's own rule (score = probability × impact); for example risk ID#02 is 4 × 4 but scored 4.
  • Milestone float in P6 is measured to project finish only, so late interim milestones still show hundreds of days of float. No consultant is named in the uploaded files.
